project_info.theme: Ultra-realistic adult portrait peeking through a torn paper heart opening
project_info.creative_direction: Minimal studio optical illusion with tactile paper fibers, natural hand depth, and gentle motivational typography
project_info.color_palette: pure white, soft pink lettering, natural skin tones, dark glossy nails, and subtle gray paper shadows

main_subject.type: clearly adult woman matching the approved face reference
main_subject.detail: adult woman with long naturally wavy hair, realistic pores and tonal variation, calm dreamy expression, strong eye focus, soft pink contact-lens effect, and natural makeup
main_subject.action: face peers through a rough heart-shaped tear while one adult hand emerges naturally through a lower tear
main_subject.styling: transparent-to-black gradient glossy nails, no clothing visible, and framing limited to face, hand, and paper

composition_elements.framing: 3:4 centered close-up with heart-shaped torn opening as the main focal point
composition_elements.paper: pure white paper with rough torn edges, visible fibers, realistic shadow, and convincing 3D depth
composition_elements.typography: soft pale-pink handwritten text Just believe at the top right near the heart curve
composition_elements.background: minimal clean white studio with no distractions

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: crisp frontal studio source at approximately 5000K with soft bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: defined clean facial shadows, readable paper fibers, gentle glossy nail highlights, and luminous but natural skin

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 50-85mm portrait lens, photoreal studio optical illusion
technical_specs.finish: sharp eyes, true-to-life proportions, subtle grain, realistic hand anatomy, no beauty-filter smoothing, and clean typography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic 3:4 close-up portrait of a clearly adult woman using the approved face reference and preserving facial identity. Show her face peeking through a torn paper heart-shaped opening as the central focal point, with rough paper edges and subtle visible fibers. One adult hand emerges naturally through a lower tear, creating convincing 3D depth. Give her long naturally wavy hair framing the face, realistic pores and tonal variation, calm dreamy expression, strong eye focus, clean realistic makeup, and a believable soft-pink contact-lens effect. Use glossy nails with a transparent black gradient and no visible clothing; keep the frame limited to face, hand, and paper. Place soft pale-pink handwritten text Just believe at the top right near the heart curve. Use a pure white minimalist studio background, crisp approximately 5000K frontal light with soft bounce, a 50-85mm portrait lens, natural proportions, and no cartoon, CGI, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike face, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, beauty filter, exaggerated eyes, warped anatomy, asymmetrical face, bad hands, extra fingers, deformed nails, harsh HDR, color banding, flat lighting, low resolution, blur, watermark, logo, text artifacts, clothing visible
